pyramiding_rule: Prohibit consecutive entries within 1.5 ATR units of a previous stop-loss execution to prevent compounding into localized liquidity sweeps.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require volumetric delta confirmation and a minimum 2-pip buffer outside recent structural consolidation highs/lows before validating stop placement.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate dynamic partial profit harvesting once unrealized gains exceed +$3.00, allowing remaining volume to run to the +$15.00-$30.00 target bracket.
